<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0103-57-18" status="unreviewed">yid
            gyi dbang pos zhi snang skye ba'i gnas byed cing yul chos kyis zhe sdang skye ba'i dmigs
            pa byed par 'dra bas so | | zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">b+han</rs> zer || | 
            
            yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3811">mu tra</rs> ba de rab du 'phug pa zhi
            sdang de yul snying du mi sdug pa lasogs kyi || de la thal nas yul snying du sdug pa la
            zhe sdang mi skye bas <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="108a9"/> tshogs bcas so | | de bzhin du 'dod chegs de yul
            sdug pa la sogs kyi srid du mi sdug pa la 'dod bas mi skye ba las pa ste || dmyigs pa la
            rtsogs pa'i thogs bcas yin no zhes zer || | </seg></TEI>
